title: Adventure T1ne
body:
Tired of mc's flat and boring terrain ?
Or the lack of exploration and structures ?
If you do, then you can try out this modpack

# Overview :
Adventure T1ne (I'm really funny) completly overhauls the vanilla world generation with mods like [BWG](https://modrinth.com/mod/oh-the-biomes-weve-gone) , [Regions Unexplored](https://modrinth.com/mod/regions-unexplored) and [Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tectonic) while staying (_somewhat_) optimized

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f41fd8540696dbc65db7db2a16c07a64eef71864_0.webp)
(Taken on the same spot and seed)
Go check the galery for better screenshot (AKA anything higher than 480p)

# Exploration :
This Modpack contain lots of new structures and way to explore the world. As well as new dimensions like [The Aether](https://modrinth.com/mod/aether), [Deeper and Darker](https://modrinth.com/mod/deeperdarker) and even a [Refurbished End ](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend) !

![Planes](https://i.ibb.co/FtsyYMx/2026-04-22-19-30-20.png)

# Performance :
Another important point is performance, while I tried to have the best possible optimization, this modpack is still ressource hungry and will run badly on weaker hardware.
- It also needs 6 gigs of ram or higher allocated to run smoothly.
- Worlds can also take a lot of space if a lot of chunks are loaded.
- If you encounter problems with chunk loadings (chunks not loading fast enough, lag..) you can try pregenerating chunks beforehand. Using /chunky start minecraft:overworld circle 0 0 (amount of chunks in x axis) (chunks in z axis). (Don't forget to disable dh when pregenerating chunks !)
- If for some reason you get the dh message "G1 garbage collector detected" you can solve this issue by adding "-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational" as jmv arguments

# Notes :
- Some of the screenshots were taken during creation of the modpack and don't exactly reflect the current worldgen
- Rebinding may be required for some mods
- The shaders used for the screenshots were [Complementary Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined), [Deritative](https://modrinth.com/shader/derivative-shader) and [Photon](https://modrinth.com/shader/photon-shader)

##   Have fun !
